parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: {{datatype|expand}}

parameters.name: MaxChildSAs
parameters.description: Controls the maximum number of child Security Association (SA) pairs that can be negotiated by a single IKEv2 session. If a new child SA pair is needed, but the current IKEv2 session already has {{param}} child SA pairs, an additional IKEv2 session (and therefore an additional IPsec tunnel) will be established. A value of 0 means no specific limit. Note that support for more than one child SA pair per IKEv2 session is OPTIONAL {{bibref|RFC5996|Section 1.3}}.

parameters.name: RemoteEndpoints
parameters.description: The host name or IP address of the remote IPsec tunnel endpoint. If more than one name/address is supplied, they will be tried in turn, i.e. they are in decreasing order of precedence.

parameters.name: ForwardingPolicy
parameters.description: Identifier of the forwarding policy associated with traffic that is associated with this profile. The forwarding policy can be referenced by entries in the {{object|##.Routing.Router.{i}.IPv4Forwarding}} and {{object|##.Routing.Router.{i}.IPv6Forwarding}} tables, and therefore allows SPD selection criteria to influence the forwarding decision.

parameters.name: Protocol
parameters.description: The "child" security protocol. This is not to be confused with {{object|#.Filter}}.{{param|#.Filter.{i}.Protocol}}, which is an SPD selector that can select packets that already have AH or ESP headers. {{object}}.{{param}} selects whether AH or ESP will be used when encapsulating a packet.

parameters.name: IKEv2AuthenticationMethod
parameters.description: IKEv2 CPE authentication method {{bibref|RFC5996|Section 2.15}}. {{reference|an enabled row in the {{object|##.Security.Certificate}} table or in another table that contains appropriate CPE credentials}} If {{empty}}, or the referenced row is disabled or deleted, the CPE chooses the authentication method based on local policy.

parameters.name: IKEv2AllowedEncryptionAlgorithms
parameters.description: Allowed IKEv2 encryption algorithms.

parameters.name: ESPAllowedEncryptionAlgorithms
parameters.description: Allowed ESP encryption algorithms.

parameters.name: IKEv2AllowedPseudoRandomFunctions
parameters.description: Allowed IKEv2 pseudo-random functions.

parameters.name: IKEv2AllowedIntegrityAlgorithms
parameters.description: Allowed IKEv2 integrity algorithms.

parameters.name: AHAllowedIntegrityAlgorithms
parameters.description: Allowed AH integrity algorithms {{bibref|IKEv2-params|Transform Type 3}} {{bibref|RFC4835|Section 3.2}}.

parameters.name: ESPAllowedIntegrityAlgorithms
parameters.description: Allowed ESP integrity algorithms {{bibref|IKEv2-params|Transform Type 3}} {{bibref|RFC4835|Section 3.1.1}}.

parameters.name: IKEv2AllowedDiffieHellmanGroupTransforms
parameters.description: Allowed IKEv2 Diffie-Hellman group transforms.

parameters.name: IKEv2DeadPeerDetectionTimeout
parameters.description: IKEv2 Dead Peer Detection (DPD) timeout in {{units}}. {{bibref|RFC5996|section 2.4}}

parameters.name: IKEv2NATTKeepaliveTimeout
parameters.description: IKEv2 NAT traversal (NAT-T) keepalive timeout in {{units}}. {{bibref|RFC3948|Section 4}}

parameters.name: AntiReplayWindowSize
parameters.description: The size of the AH or ESP Anti-Replay Window. {{bibref|RFC4302|Section B.2}} {{bibref|RFC4303|Section A2}} A value of 0 means that Sequence Number Verification is disabled.

parameters.name: DoNotFragment
parameters.description: Controls the value of the ''Do Not Fragment'' (DF) bit. {{bibref|RFC4301|Section 8.1}}

parameters.name: DSCPMarkPolicy
parameters.description: DSCP with which to mark the outer IP header for traffic that is associated with this IPsec channel. A value of -1 indicates copy from the incoming packet. A value of -2 indicates automatic marking of DSCP. De-tunneled packets are never re-marked. Automatic DSCP marking behavior is a local matter to the CPE, possibly influenced by other Broadband Forum standards that it supports.

parameters.name: IKEv2SATrafficLimit
parameters.description: IKEv2 SA lifetime in {{units}}, or zero if there is no traffic constraint on its expiration. If both {{param}} and {{param|IKEv2SATimeLimit}} are non-zero, the IKEv2 SA is deleted when the first limit is reached.

parameters.name: IKEv2SATimeLimit
parameters.description: IKEv2 SA lifetime in {{units}}, or zero if there is no time constraint on its expiration. If both {{param}} and {{param|IKEv2SATrafficLimit}} are non-zero, the IKEv2 SA is deleted when the first limit is reached.

parameters.name: IKEv2SAExpiryAction
parameters.description: Action to take when an IKEv2 SA expires, whether as a result of hitting a traffic limit or a time limit.

parameters.name: ChildSATrafficLimit
parameters.description: Child SA lifetime in {{units}}, or zero if there is no traffic constraint on its expiration. If both {{param}} and {{param|ChildSATimeLimit}} are non-zero, the child SA is deleted when the first limit is reached.

parameters.name: ChildSATimeLimit
parameters.description: Child SA lifetime in {{units}}, or zero if there is no time constraint on its expiration. If both {{param}} and {{param|ChildSATrafficLimit}} are non-zero, the child SA is deleted when the first limit is reached.

parameters.name: ChildSAExpiryAction
parameters.description: Action to take when a Child SA expires, whether as a result of hitting a traffic limit or a time limit.

parameters.name: SentCPAttrNumberOfEntries
parameters.description: {{numentries}}

object.description: Profile table that represents the IPsec Security Policy Database (SPD) {{bibref|RFC4301|Section 4.4.1}} processing info. Each entry defines the IPsec treatment for packets that match the {{object|#.Filter}} entries that reference the entry.
